speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Relocating the wind park has transferred environmental pressures to sensitive offshore habitats.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: The new location has also introduced legal uncertainty due to Arcadia's limited authority within the Exclusive Economic Zone.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: Our fishing grounds were preserved, but the broader conflict between marine protection, energy development and jurisdiction remains unresolved.

speaker: SECRETARY-GENERAL
text: The project continues, but its long-term sustainability is now subject to significant uncertainty.
